about: This manifest lists every picture, scan, logo, mark and font file kept under motion/ for the seven published films (blog-designing-docs, blog-fuma-nama, jihe-yuanben, journey-to-the-west, modern-hebrew, gif-how-gt-works, slash-announcement) and the shared kit, by motion-relative path, with its size, SHA-256, a byte-identical tracked twin outside motion/ when the L6 worktree has one, and the code that uses it. Source, licence and credit come only from the films' CREDITS.txt, BRIEF.md sources sections, assets/SOURCES*.md, font README and OFL files, NOTES.md, kit/endcard/README.md and MOTION.md, and redistribute says whether the bytes may enter the public repo (yes), are General Translation's own (own), or stay out (no), with the reason in why. kit/vendor.mjs copies every entry that has a twin; the one entry marked tracked (kit/brand/gt-mark.svg) is in the repository under motion/; every other entry stays in the local motion folder and is fetched from its source.
